Hosting serves the contents of leads/ at the root of your Firebase domain,
so the dashboard lands on https://<project>.web.app/ rather than a /leads/
subpath. Source files that are not part of the running app are excluded.
The functions block is the calendar service behind the dashboard's
'Find a time' tab. It is the only place the GoHighLevel token exists — see
leads/functions/README.md. Cloud Functions needs the Blaze plan.
This exists because GitHub Pages stopped assigning runners to this repo's
build. Firebase Hosting is independent of that, and you are already in this
console setting up Auth and Firestore.
